title: hieracium malmioi
intro: Hieracium malmioi, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to southern Africa. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including pain, inflammation, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium malmioi include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium malmioi include iridoid glycosides, harpagoside, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
